description: Linux kernel driver for GCA230718 LED support via I2C, managing RGBW LEDs connected to the GCA230718 chip, including initialization, sequence control, and LED brightness management.

classes.name: gca230718_led
classes.description: Represents an individual LED connected to the GCA230718, including brightness and associated I2C client.

classes.name: gca230718_private
classes.description: Holds private data for the driver, including mutex lock and array of LEDs.

methods.name: gca230718_init_private_led_data
methods.description: Initializes the private data structure for LEDs, setting client pointers to NULL.

methods.name: gca230718_send_sequence
methods.description: Sends initialization or update sequences to the LED controller via I2C, setting brightness levels.

methods.name: gca230718_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specific LED by updating internal state and sending control sequences.

methods.name: gca230718_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is detected, sets up LEDs, and sends startup sequences.

methods.name: gca230718_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the device is removed.
